North Park Loops (Premier Bicycle Club)

Wexford, PA · North Park · Road

North Park Loops (Premier Bicycle Club) is a road group ride in Wexford, PA. It rolls every Wednesday at 5:00 pm from North Park Ice Skating Rink, Olympia parking lot.

Next ride Wed, Oct 7, 5:00 PM EDT

For visitors

Registration is required (on the club's calendar). The club lists a Guest Concierge on its home page: guest-concierge@premierbicycleclub.org. Arrive early for the pre-ride briefing, 5 minutes before roll-out.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the North Park Loops (Premier Bicycle Club) group ride

A Wednesday-evening club road ride of about 29 miles around North Park at a Moderate 14 mph. Late-season evenings get dark early: bring lights.
